title: Slovakian Beef Stew with a Twist
description: A Chinese-Style Beef Stew made with a unique twist of Slovakian flavors, served hot and steaming.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, sliced peppers, and minced garlic to the wok.
Cook until the peppers are tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the wok, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the cooked beef, stew seasoning, soy sauce, lime juice, and ginger to the wok.
Stir-fry everything together for about 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and steaming, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
